absent: Full structure layouts for address spaces, areas, regions, walkers and dump state beyond fields touched here.
Lock semantics and global ordering for address space, region and mapping locks beyond nesting shown.
Numeric values for error codes, protection flags and system call numbers.
Behavior of area lookup, page pinning, page copy, iterator and task lookup helpers owned elsewhere.
Page table level configuration, leaf detection and protection bit interpretation across architectures.
Boot ordering and tuning rationale for user and admin reserve initialization.

findings.text: Teardown for an address space ignores a null descriptor, clears total size accounting, then under exclusive lock walks every area from zero, detaches and destroys each area with periodic rescheduling, destroys the map tree and releases the lock.

No memory management unit resize aligns old and new lengths and rejects zero length, unaligned start, fixed relocation to a different address, absence of an exact mapping, mismatch between requested old length and area extent, shared file backed areas, and growth beyond the enclosing region, otherwise it sets area end to start plus new length and returns start.
Resize system entry serializes the internal resize helper with the current address space exclusive lock held across the call and returns the helper status.

Frame mapping helper accepts only identity correspondence between address and frame number scaled by page size and otherwise fails, while success marks the area as device backed, frame mapped, unexpandable and undumpable.

Device memory mapper derives a frame number from physical start, measures area length from its bounds, advances by the area page offset, and forwards area start with computed frame, length and protection to the input output remap helper.

Vmalloc range remap requires the user mapping flag and fails without it, otherwise it moves area start to the supplied address advanced by page offset and preserves size by setting area end accordingly.
In this no memory management unit configuration the file cache fault and multi page map entry points are unreachable and invoke the fatal bug trap when called.

Remote access takes the target address space read lock in killable form and yields zero length when interrupted, locates the area containing the start, truncates length to area end, allows write only where write permission exists and read only where read permission exists with zero otherwise, then releases the lock.

One wrapper forwards address, buffer, length and flags directly to the internal remote access helper, while the task oriented wrapper rejects wrapping ranges, pins the task address space, forwards on success and releases the reference.

Remote string copy presets output to empty, takes the read lock killable, requires start inside a mapping, guards length addition against overflow, caps length to mapping end, copies only where read permission exists with truncation fallback on copy failure, while the task wrapper handles zero length early and missing address space with empty output and fault status plus reference management.

Truncation nests the global region write semaphore outside the inode mapping read lock, scans the dying page range and aborts busy when any shared mapping overlaps it, otherwise walks all mappings to shrink overlapping shared regions and their ends down to the new size, then unlocks in reverse order.

Both reserve initializers sample global free page state converted to kilobytes and retain the smaller of one thirty second of free memory and a fixed power of two cap, with a larger cap for user reserve than for admin reserve.
Duplicate mapping helper holds the old address space exclusive lock while propagating the executable file reference to the new space, then unlocks and reports success.

Debug table walk asserts exclusive locks on both target space and initial space to stabilize user teardown and kernel table freeing, rejects empty ranges and unsafe operation sets, then walks the requested span from page global directory level with area less mode.
Area scoped walk binds a walker to the area space, area and private data, rejects missing space and unsafe operations, applies configured memory and area walk locks, then walks exactly the area span.
Header guard macro provides inclusion protection for the page allocation tracking header.
Young flag helper tests and clears youth for the given address and flushes the translation for that page only when it was previously young, returning prior youth.
Table free callback recovers the enclosing page descriptor from the callback header and releases it as a page table without consulting an address space.
Global kernel table reclamation context contains a pending list, a spinlock protecting that list, and a work item bound to the drain routine, all statically initialized.

Kernel table pages move from queued under lock to scheduled background work unless booting, then worker splices the queue privately, issues a global kernel range invalidation and frees each descriptor, with an early initializer scheduling the drain once workqueues exist.

Per page copier proceeds while remaining length and iterator space remain, bounds each chunk to the rest of the page and remaining length, copies in the direction selected by the write flag, subtracts progress, resets intra page offset after the first page, and fails when a short copy occurs while iterator space remains.
Constant value two caps heap allocation for remote page pointer arrays to two pages worth for reliability.
Constant defines how many page pointers fit in the capped allocation given page size and pointer size.
Constant value sixteen sizes the on stack page pointer array used for small remote transfers.

Single remote vector handler ignores empty length, computes the encompassing page count with page alignment, requests write permission when writing, then in bounded chunks pins remote pages under read lock, caps transferable bytes to remaining length, delegates to the per page copier, advances addresses and counts, and unpins with dirty marking on writes.

Core cross process engine precomputes the largest page span across remote vectors and returns early when none, uses stack storage for small spans and bounded heap allocation otherwise, resolves the target task and address space with translation of access denied to operation not permitted, iterates remote vectors until iterator exhaustion or error, converts any partial progress into a byte count, and releases task, space and heap resources.

Vector entry requires zero flags, imports local vectors with direction chosen by operation and bails when empty, imports remote vectors with compatibility awareness, delegates to the core engine and frees imported vectors, with read and write system entries selecting the corresponding direction.

Dump callbacks fetch each level entry, divert early address sanitizer shadow tables to a single page reporter, invoke optional effective protection hooks, report leaf entries and all leaf table entries with continuation request, while the hole handler reports zeroed entries selected by walk depth through a shared operation table.

Dump driver holds online memory references across the walk, takes the target exclusive lock plus the initial space lock with nesting when different, walks each configured range with the dump operation set, then releases locks in reverse, drops the memory reference and flushes pending output.
Write execute check handler reports success or failure based on the checker predicate, and the initializer registers a read only debug file for that handler.

Readahead state initializer pulls the device default page count and marks previous position invalid, while kernel readahead rejects empty or unreadable files, missing mappings or operations, non regular non block types and anonymous files, otherwise forwards offset and length as a will need advisory with a three argument system entry.
Marker macro enables trace point creation for the readahead compilation unit.
Remote access paths guard against address wraparound and length overflow by rejecting the request or truncating it to the containing mapping before touching memory.
